figurative_meaning_en: to do nothing or waste time/effort uselessly
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি ছাই করছো, কাজে মন দাও।
এসব ছাই করার সময় নেই, তাড়াতাড়ি শেষ করো।
example_sentences_in_english: You're just wasting time, focus on the work.
We don't have time for this nonsense, finish it quickly.
note: Often used to dismiss idle or unproductive talk in Bengali vernacular.
